answer_1.quote: We turned MCQs in AV-Human into open-ended questions, where the original correct option is used as the reference answer. The generated answer was ranked using GPT-4o and Rouge-L.
answer_1.outputs: open-ended answers to audio-centric video understanding questions

answer_2.quote: Performance is measured by accuracy (%) on MCQs.

answer_3.quote: The generated answer was ranked using GPT-4o and Rouge-L.

answer_4.quote: Annotators were tasked with collecting 2700 YouTube videos for each of 18 specified video domains.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators performed a rationality check on each question-answer pair to ensure it met the following criteria: Audio Dependence, Clear Distinctions, No External Knowledge, Data Formatting.
